description: This Java class defines a command handler for activating fixed deposit accounts within the Fineract platform. It implements processing logic to handle 'ACTIVATE' commands for fixed deposit account entities, delegating the activation process to a service class.

classes.name: ActivateFixedDepositAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles activation commands for fixed deposit accounts. It processes command objects and calls the corresponding service method to activate the account.

methods.name: ActivateFixedDepositAccountCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the deposit account writing service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the activation command by delegating to the deposit account service to activate the fixed deposit account.
